title: Government-aided boys' schools cannot refuse deployment of women teachers: Madras High Court
description: The Madras High Court recently held that government-aided boys' schools cannot refuse to accommodate women teachers solely because of their gender [Saratha v The Chief Educational Officer & Ors.].
